arithmetic_lineage.bounded_bridge_audit: Alexeev records the source chamber, Shimada records X_2 and its 478-wall chamber, and the prior project ledger recorded this A15 row without a K3 carrier; the exact composed bridge appears unrecorded in that bounded comparison
arithmetic_lineage.priority_scope: bounded evidence only; no worldwide-priority claim

generic_F_polarized_K3_carrier.effectivity_scope: after Weyl re-marking and sign orientation, Riemann--Roch makes the 11 primitive square-minus-two classes effective; irreducibility is not asserted
generic_F_polarized_K3_carrier.existence: F occurs primitively in the K3 lattice through its saturated occurrence in NS(X_2); outside the countable Noether--Lefschetz hyperplanes, the F-polarized period has NS exactly F

reusable_carrier_criterion.full_nef_gate: Promotion from divisor-reflection subsystem to full nef chamber is separate and requires the ambient-root one-sign criterion; it is not proved here.
reusable_carrier_criterion.statement: If an even Lorentzian chamber lattice M has a finite-index even reflection-stable overclosure N, N embeds primitively in the K3 lattice, and the chamber passes literal finite-volume tests, then a very general N-polarized projective K3 has NS=N and carries the chamber as a full-rank divisor-reflection subsystem. Weyl re-marking puts a strict chamber point in the ample cone and K3 Riemann--Roch orients every primitive square-minus-two facet effectively.

scope.generic_K3_Y: all 21 reflections are integral on full NS(Y)=F, but they are not asserted to extend to Hodge isometries or surface automorphisms; extra roots may refine the chamber
scope.named_X2: F=NS(X_2)^iota is a primitive invariant divisor sublattice of rank-20 NS(X_2); only the 11 square-minus-two reflections extend integrally to full NS(X_2), while all ten square-minus-four reflections fail
scope.not_fixed_nef_section: the 21-wall chamber is not Shimada's 37-wall restriction of the complete 478-wall induced nef chamber
scope.novelty: new project-level K3/divisor realization of a known arithmetic chamber; no new abstract polytope, lattice class, or maximal reflection group is claimed

theorem: The A15_11 C02 H10/21 finite-volume chamber has a very-general K3 carrier with full NS=U+E8(-2)+<-2>; the same lattice also occurs as the actual invariant divisor lattice NS(X_2)^iota on Shimada's named X_2.
